detail.name: One of a Kind
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Yidhari's Mindscape: At Last, a Peaceful Dream
detail.desc2:
A card with Yidhari's personal photo printed on it.
"From the moment I saw your eyes in that illusion, I understood..."
"After that, I no longer feared my mind would be consumed by the void, nor that I would be lost to the abyss."
"Because within the illusion, I found the one and only reality I could look to."
